H100686
Welcome to this inviting townhouse in Oakwood Hills, offering easy, low-maintenance living with a bright open-concept design. The spacious layout connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas.

This home features a primary suite, comfortable guest bedroom and a second full bathroom, providing flexibility for guests, or a home office. The attached garage adds convenience and additional storage, while the thoughtfully designed floor plan maximizes both space and functionality.

Located in a desirable community, this townhouse combines comfort, style, and convenience—an ideal place to call home.
